core: Leading-edge actin protrusion in cell migration
name: Arp2/3-driven lamellipodial protrusion at the migrating leading edge
rationale: All members regulate leading-edge actin protrusions (lamellipodia, pseudopodia, ruffles) and spreading/migration; unlike the confusables, the theme carries Arp2/3 nucleation, WASP/WAVE activation and lamellipodium assembly rather than macropinocytosis/podosomes, actin severing/capping or CDC42/IQGAP/adhesion-disassembly signalling.

name: Methionine cycle and selenium compound metabolism
rationale: Members cover methionine salvage/biosynthesis, SAM metabolism and its inborn errors plus dietary selenium (SeMet, selenite, MeSeH) processing that runs through the same enzymes; the selenium members are what the confusables (folate, choline/carnitine, MTR/MTRR defects) lack.

core: Double-strand break end resection and homology-directed repair
qualifier: HR, single-strand annealing and MMEJ subpathways with BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 defects
name: Resection-dependent double-strand break repair (HR, SSA, MMEJ)
rationale: All members concern DSB end processing/resection and the resection-dependent repair routes (homologous recombination with D-loop resolution, SSA, alt-NHEJ) and their BRCA/PALB2 defects, whereas the confusables centre on DSB sensing, ATM signalling, classical NHEJ and PARylation.

name: Phospholipid transfer at ER membrane contact sites
rationale: Members describe intermembrane PI/PC transfer and ER tethering/localization at contact sites; confusables instead cover flippase translocation, sphingolipid or glycolipid transport, or ER tubular network shaping without lipid transfer.

name: Trans-Golgi clathrin vesicle sorting to lysosome-related organelles
rationale: Members concern clathrin/adaptor vesicle biogenesis and cargo loading at the TGN directing cargo to lysosomes, melanosomes, platelet dense granules and secretory vesicles; confusables lack the lysosome-related organelle members and instead hold endosome-Golgi or Golgi-ER retrograde transport.

name: IL-15 and IL-21 signaling in NK cell development
rationale: Members are IL-15 and IL-21 signaling and NK cell proliferation/differentiation; confusables carry IL-2/7/9 (T cell) or IL-10/12/23 signaling instead.

qualifier: lectin/ficolin and classical initiation to C3/C5 activation
name: Complement activation via lectin and classical pathways
rationale: All members describe complement activation and opsonization, initiated by ficolin/lectin and antibody (classical) routes; confusables add the alternative pathway and regulators of the cascade while lacking the lectin/ficolin members.

name: Myeloid proinflammatory cytokine and chemokine production
rationale: Members are inflammatory cytokine/chemokine signatures of myeloid and dendritic cells and regulation of IL-8/MCP-1 production and chronic inflammation; confusables instead centre on monocyte activation, chemotaxis and extravasation or lymphocyte/NF-kB activation modules.

name: FRS2/SHC adaptor signaling downstream of FGFR1 and FGFR2
rationale: All members are FRS-, SHC- or PLC-mediated cascades of FGFR1/FGFR2; confusables hold ligand binding, activating mutants, FGFR4 or PI3K cascades instead.

qualifier: calcium-dependent control of glutamate and GABA secretion
name: Presynaptic calcium control of glutamate and GABA release
rationale: Members regulate presynaptic Ca2+ and synaptic vesicle exocytosis to tune glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission; confusables cover the vesicle fusion/priming machinery and monoamine release cycles, or G-protein/kainate presynaptic inhibition.

name: Locomotor, postural and sensorimotor behavior
rationale: Members are locomotory, postural (righting reflex, proprioception), exploratory and sensorimotor behaviors with their neural substrates (glycinergic inhibition, Purkinje layer); confusables instead hold vocalization, learning and auditory/prepulse behaviors or neuronal excitability without locomotor members.

qualifier: MHC class II peptide presentation by antigen-presenting cells
name: MHC class II peptide presentation by antigen-presenting cells
rationale: Members are MHC class II exogenous peptide loading/regulation and the surface signatures of DCs, monocytes and other APCs; confusables carry CD1 lipid presentation/NKT, B cell identity or T cell costimulation instead.

qualifier: in mesoderm fate and heart morphogenesis
name: BMP-SMAD regulation of mesoderm fate and heart morphogenesis
rationale: Members are BMP/SMAD signaling and its regulation together with mesoderm specification and heart, pericardial and coronary vascular morphogenesis; confusables have trabeculation, second heart field or arterial/endothelial differentiation instead of the BMP-mesoderm members.

name: Fructose and glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members cover fructose synthesis/catabolism and its inherited disorders plus glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate and alditol metabolism; confusables instead carry gluconeogenesis/alanine, galactose or pentose/glucuronate metabolism.

name: Osmotic stress response and sodium-potassium transport regulation
rationale: Members cover hyper/hypo-osmotic and salt stress responses, water homeostasis and regulation of Na+/K+/Cl- transport; confusables either lack the osmotic responses (aldosterone-Na+ import) or lack Na+/K+ transport while adding vasopressin-aquaporin water handling.

core: Eicosanoid and oxidized fatty acid metabolism
qualifier: lipoxygenase and cytochrome P450 (omega-hydroxylase, epoxygenase) routes
name: Lipoxygenase and cytochrome P450 eicosanoid metabolism
rationale: Members are biosynthesis/catabolism of leukotrienes, lipoxins, HETEs, hepoxilins and EETs by lipoxygenases and P450 hydroxylases/epoxygenases, plus fatty-acid transport and skin defects in that pathway; confusables add eicosanoid receptors or pro-resolving mediators and lack the P450 members.

name: Antimicrobial peptide and mucosal innate defense against microbes
rationale: Members concern host killing of bacteria, fungi and parasites by defensins and other antimicrobial peptides, metal sequestration and mucosal/microbiota defense; confusables are Listeria entry, intestinal epithelial maintenance or neutrophil degranulation/respiratory burst.

qualifier: FOXO regulation and HSF1 heat shock response
name: FOXO and HSF1 transcriptional responses to heat and oxidative stress
rationale: Members are AKT/acetylation control of FOXO transcription and the HSF1 heat shock response with protein refolding and UPRmt; the HSF1/heat members distinguish it from confusables that pair FOXO with NFE2L2, p53/mTORC1 or ER-stress UPR.

name: Cytoplasmic translation initiation and ribosomal subunit joining
rationale: Members cover eIF2 ternary complex/43S formation, scanning and start codon recognition, eIF3, 60S joining and elongation; confusables are rRNA/Pol I-III transcription or translation termination, NMD and ribosome quality control.

name: MET receptor signaling through PI3K, SHP2 and RAP1
rationale: All three members are MET-activated effector branches (PI3K/AKT, PTPN11, RAP1/RAC1); confusables are generic PI3K/AKT, MET-PTK2/integrin adhesion, EGFR/ERBB2 or FGFR cascades.

name: Planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension
rationale: Members are PCP establishment and Wnt/PCP signaling with convergent extension in gastrulation, axis elongation, organogenesis and neural plate shaping; confusables are axial mesoderm, floor plate and neural plate patterning without PCP.

qualifier: dietary uptake, plasma transport and intracellular processing
name: Cobalamin absorption, transport and intracellular processing
rationale: Members are cobalamin uptake (CBLIF, cubam), TCN2/CD320 transport, ABCD4/MMACHC/MMADHC processing and their deficiency diseases; confusables are other B-vitamin metabolism or downstream methylmalonyl/propionyl-CoA defects.

Members mix magnesium transport/homeostasis, inositol transport and metabolism, tight-junction paracellular transport and adhesion, and generic protein homo/hetero-oligomerization and ER membrane insertion terms, with no single biological process true of all of them.

core: Nucleic acid sensing for type I interferon
name: Endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING sensing driving type I interferon
rationale: Members are endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 trafficking and signaling (and their HSE deficiencies), cGAS-STING regulation and IFN-alpha/beta and DC cytokine production; confusables centre on RIG-I/IRF3 cytosolic RNA sensing and interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors.

name: Histidine-histamine metabolism and proton-coupled peptide transport
rationale: Members are histidine catabolism, histamine metabolism/receptors/response and proton-coupled oligopeptide/histidine transport; the histamine and histidine-catabolism members are what the amino acid transporter confusables lack.
